title: Uh zombie thingy
description: Its just a zombie modpack, nuffin too special about it tbh.
body: Mostly a pack made for the fun of it. A basic zombie pack that revolves around horde mods like undead nights with a bit of fun to it. For one Pvz is added to it with one of the mods. Other than that mostrly personal but I have no qualms for anyone else using it.
